profile.summary: SerayaEryn is a Mid-Level JavaScript developer with specialized expertise in Fastify, a high-performance Node.js web framework. Their contributions focus on core Fastify functionality, TypeScript integration, and documentation improvements. Evidence from 13 PRs demonstrates deep knowledge of Fastify's middleware hooks, error handling, serialization, and plugin architecture. They also contribute to Fastify's ecosystem by maintaining documentation and adding community plugins. While primarily backend-focused, their work reflects strong problem-solving skills in Node.js HTTP server internals and TypeScript type safety.
skill_evidence: Expose the default json serializer (Fastify serialization access)
Pass request to the onsend hook on 422 and 415 errors (HTTP error handling)
Add support for class-based plugins (Fastify plugin architecture)
Add typings for disableRequestLogging option (TypeScript type definitions)
Add fastify-compression to Ecosystem.md (plugin ecosystem contributions)
